honesty: Site plans are AUTHORED: no real site, parcel, address, survey, zoning or partner is represented. Hall footprints and heights are DERIVED from the bundle's own interior plans. Campus coordinates carry the geo registry's own provenance tag, copied.

inputs.part: only the text campusplan reads: CLEAR_BASE_M, HEADROOM_M, clear_height, STYLE_OF, CITY_S, the campus R, the walk pad, the sims-yard YR max, km per degree, the city log radius

rules.lots_per_side_choice: per district, the number of double-loaded spines k (1..6) that makes the block most nearly square (minimise max(width, depth), ties -> fewer spines)
rules.provenance: AUTHORED - site-planning rules typed by the campusplan pack author; no real site, parcel, zoning code or survey is represented
rules.sims_yard_side_m_from: 2 x the builder's own maximum sims-yard radius (web/build_3d.py `const YR = Math.min(<max>, ...)`), read at build time
rules.slots_note: district order is the union registry's; district 0 keeps the north slot as today when there are three; with two, west/east so the south stays open for the gate
rules.yard_words_note: a hall gets an outdoor training yard behind its building when one of these words appears in the fixtures web/interiors.py derived for it, or in its registry name/focus (pack/registry/halls.json); every word must match at least one hall, or the build stops
